observations: Three photos show a pair of black neckband-style wireless earphones with in-ear buds.
Photo 0: Side view showing the earbuds, neckband, and inline control module. The neckband has a glossy finish.
Photo 1: Similar angle to photo 0, showing the same design with a visible 'Jiji.ng' watermark.
Photo 2: Front view of the neckband, clearly showing the brand name 'JOWAY' printed in white on the black surface.
The earbuds are connected by thin black wires to a flexible neckband.
The inline control module has three buttons (likely for power, call, and volume or track control).
No charging case is visible in any photo.
No text or labels indicating model number or specifications are visible beyond the brand name.

claims.claim: Caller vibration reminder function, so that you do not miss every important phone
claims.evidence: No visible vibration motor or indicator in the photos. This feature cannot be confirmed or denied from images alone.
No battery capacity label or specification visible in any photo. The number '160mAh' is not readable on the device.

risks.risk: The earphones may not have a caller vibration reminder function as claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up of the neckband or earbuds showing a vibration motor or a demonstration video of the vibration during a call.

risks.risk: The battery capacity may not be 160mAh as claimed.
risks.proof: A label or specification sheet showing the battery capacity, or a charging indicator showing the capacity.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown battery capacity, likely lower than advertised

risks.risk: The earphones may be non-functional or have poor sound quality.
risks.proof: A video demonstrating the earphones turning on, connecting to a device, and playing audio.

risks.risk: The earphones may be damaged or have broken wires or controls.
risks.proof: A close-up of the inline control module and wires showing no fraying or damage.

proof_requests: A close-up photo or video showing the vibration function during a call.
A photo or video showing the battery capacity label or charging indicator.
A video demonstrating the earphones turning on, connecting to a phone, and playing audio.
A close-up of the inline control module and wires to check for damage.
response.reason: The brand 'JOWAY' is visible, but the model is not readable. Key claims about vibration function and battery capacity cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks include non-functionality, damage, and false specifications. Proof is needed to confirm functionality and specifications before pricing.
